subject: Solstice Labs vendor intake — DPA, SOC 2 link, PO routing
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@solsticelabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + security artifacts for Solstice Labs

Hi Soojin —

We're getting ready to onboard Redwood for a pilot later this quarter. Procurement at Solstice needs the usual vendor pack so we can create the PO and get finance approval. Could you share: 
- DPA (or standard data processing terms) we can attach to our PO
- Link to current SOC 2 report or an attestation we can share with our security team
- Current subprocessor list (names and purposes)
- Any vendor intake form we should complete and preferred PO routing (email / portal / contact)

Also: does Redwood host customer data outside the US by default? If so what regions?

We will likely need an invoice and a billing contact for PO routing — I can provide the internal details once I know the flow. Target kickoff: pilot start week of 2026-06-21.

Thanks,
Emily Hart
Head of Platform Security
Solstice Labs

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@solsticelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + security artifacts for Solstice Labs

Hi Emily —

Welcome — happy to help get Solstice set up. Please find the items below and a couple of next steps so procurement can route the PO cleanly. Attachments: Solstice_vendor_intake_form.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf, subprocessors_list_2026-05.csv

Quick answers up front:
- Data residency: Redwood’s hosted offering stores customer data in the region you select; default for US tenants is us-west-2 and us-east-1. Private/Reserved deployments can be VPC-only.
- SOC 2: link to the most recent report (redacted): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/2025-09-report.pdf

PO routing and billing steps:
1) Fill out the attached vendor intake form (company details, W-9 if US) and return to procurement@redwoodinference.com
2) Send a formal PO referencing deal id SOL-2026-042 to procurement@redwoodinference.com (we process Net30 by default)
3) If you need a contract signature, use this DocuSign link to review our standard SOW and execution flow: https://app.docusign.com/solstice-contract/abcdef123456

Ben (cc) handles vendor activation and AP. Ben — can you confirm if Net30 is fine and whether we need tax docs up front for Solstice?

If you want us to accept a redline to the DPA, please send the proposed edits and Laura (legal) will review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Soojin —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve attached the completed vendor intake and included our billing contact below: 
- Billing: Victoria Chan, finance@solsticelabs.com | +1 415-555-0199

A couple of follow-ups from our security team after scanning the subprocessor list:
- We see a third-party analytics vendor (thirdparty-analytics.io) listed as a subprocessor for usage telemetry. Can you confirm whether telemetry includes any PII or account identifiers?
- For the DPA, we will likely request two small edits around deletion timelines and subprocessors notification; do you prefer a redline or an annotated list of the requested clauses?

We are aiming for PO issuance by 2026-05-20 so finance can process on time for the June pilot.

Thanks,
Emily

Hi Emily / Soojin —

Net30 is fine on our end. Procurement will accept a PO sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com. For US companies we generally require a W-9 before sending the first invoice; if Solstice is non-US we will take a W-8BEN or equivalent. Victoria can send the W-9 to procurement@redwoodinference.com and we’ll provision the vendor record.

I’ll start the vendor activation once we have:
- Completed intake form
- W-9 (if US) or tax equivalent
- PO referencing SOL-2026-042

Expect vendor record be provisioned within 2 business days after docs are received.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Vendor Activation | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@solsticelabs.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + security artifacts for Solstice Labs

Emily —

Thanks for the heads up on the edits. If you can send a redline to the attached DPA, that will make review fastest. I’ve attached a document with two recommended clarifications for your review: DPA_redline_solstice.docx (edits include: 1) standardizing deletion timeline to 90 days unless otherwise agreed; 2) adding a 30-day notification window for subprocessor additions).

On telemetry: Redwood’s usage telemetry is aggregated and does not include customer PII by default; account identifiers (internal customer IDs) are used for billing/usage correlation but are pseudonymized in reports. If Solstice needs a dedicated telemetry exclusion we can turn that off for the pilot deployment.

Happy to sync quick if you prefer to walk through the redline — I am free tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
